title: Wafer Geometry Measurement - Stacking Faults Detection on eDR-7100
subtitle: Post-Planarization Quality Validation for 3nm Node Manufacturing
author: Michael Torres

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the eDR-7100 system to detect and classify Stacking Faults defects during post-planarization inspection at the 3nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 12 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Stacking Faults defects that are critical to yield at the 3nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the eDR-7100 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: eDR-7100
- Inspection Type: Wafer Geometry Measurement
- Target Defect: Stacking Faults
- Process Step: Post-Planarization
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 3nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 12

This test case applies to all eDR-7100 systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 12 for post-planarization monitoring in the 3nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: eDR-7100
Software Version: v11.9.506
Recipe: WAFER_GEOMETRY_MEASUREMENT_3nm_POST_PLANARIZATION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: Low (114 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 2mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the eDR-7100 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Wafer Geometry Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Stacking Faults defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 3nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 96 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 94% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±0.8% for Wafer Geometry Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.98 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-12-14
Wafers Tested: 28
Total Defects Found: 4901
Defect Density: 1560.04 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 1.6%
Capture Rate: 94.9%
Test Duration: 454 minutes
System Uptime: 99.9%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The eDR-7100 demonstrated excellent performance in detecting Stacking Faults at the 3nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Edge-zone defect detection showed improved performance compared to previous revision.

e) Recipe portability between systems at this fab was confirmed.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
